description: Version 0.4.1 raw assembly baseline, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0. SD CRC7/CRC16, shared release/link identity, hardened BDOS and filesystem, physical SD/SRAM activity LEDs and KiB format progress. VT52-style console parser in resident RAM; 51200-byte TPA (512 bytes reserved for terminal support). Disk geometry unchanged. D: dashboard label changed to CALC for bundled SuperCalc2. OPEN treats an uninitialized out-of-range S2 field as extent zero for MS COBOL-80 LINK-80 compatibility. Reviewed NL/UK physical keyboard corrections and ASCII-to-native underscore/bracket/grave rendering.
